subject.title: refactor(prompt): use plain inbound context labels and drop system-tag sanitizer

question: Should this PR retain a narrow system-event queue boundary that prevents externally supplied multiline text from rendering as extra `System:` prompt lines while removing only the cosmetic bracket-tag rewriting?
rationale: The intended security boundary is a product and trust-model choice: the branch deliberately removes a broad sanitizer, but the remaining model-visible system-event encoding must still distinguish untrusted caller text from renderer-owned `System:` lines.

options.title: Restore narrow queue isolation
options.body: Neutralize only line-leading `System:` in queued event content or use an equivalent unambiguous renderer encoding, while leaving bracket-tag text unchanged.

options.title: Accept raw multiline event text
options.body: Treat all queue producers as trusted and accept that external-looking event content may render with an additional `System:` prefix.

recommendation.title: Restore narrow queue isolation
recommendation.body: Neutralize only line-leading `System:` in queued event content or use an equivalent unambiguous renderer encoding, while leaving bracket-tag text unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent inbound metadata and prompt-composition surface on current main.
